name: elevenlabs_tts
description: Generate downloadable MP3 speech with ElevenLabs (paid API, no automatic playback)

tools.name: elevenlabs_tts
tools.description: Generate an MP3 file with ElevenLabs only when the user requests spoken audio. Speaks the supplied text exactly; does not translate, clone voices or play audio. This is a paid call without automatic retries. Returns a local path and dashboard download URL, not audio/base64. A voice ID must be supplied or configured.

text.description: Exact text to speak, already in the intended language (maximum 5000 characters)

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice ID; otherwise uses elevenlabs_tts_voice_id context or ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID

model_id.description: TTS model; context/environment default or eleven_multilingual_v2

language_code.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language hint for supported models. Not supported by eleven_multilingual_v2; omit for automatic language. Does not translate text.
